# BetEdge AI

> Football analytics and prediction terminal powered by live iSportsAPI data. Corner and match-outcome engines with 75%+ confidence discipline.

## Pages

- [Dashboard](/): Configure and launch live football scans.
- [Corner Predictions](/corners): Over 6.5 / 7.5 corner picks grouped by scan.
- [Match Outcomes](/matches): Match winner, double chance, Asian handicap, Over 1.5 goals.
- [History](/history): Persistent record of every scan with FT result tracking.
- [Settings](/settings): API status and engine configuration.
